description: Is a company hiring, how much and for which functions? Open jobs read from its public ATS job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Personio, Workable, Teamtailor, Workday), summarized as buying signals: open_jobs, posted_last_30d, hiring_intent (low/medium/high), jobs by function (sales, engineering, data...), leadership roles. From a web domain (any country), a French SIREN or a French company name. Chain with find_decision_makers to know who to contact. 0.01 USDC per call, charged only if open jobs are found.

domain.description: Company web domain, e.g. acme.com (any country)

name: hiring_signals
